explanation: This is a definitional (`rfl`) lemma that unfolds the library's own definition `Valuation.absoluteValueUniformEquiv`, which is defined at line 54 of the same file. Its content lies entirely in that definition. Mathlib has no `absoluteValueUniformEquiv` and no uniform equivalence `WithVal v ≃ᵤ WithAbs v.absoluteValue`. Grepping for `≃ᵤ WithAbs` and `WithVal … ≃ᵤ` finds only `IsEquiv.uniformEquiv`, the uniform equivalence `WithVal v ≃ᵤ R` defined right after it in `WithVal.lean`, and a p-adic equivalence. None of these is related to this statement.
